summary: Firebase removal and JWT-based auth migration testing completed. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend tests passed - Firebase completely removed, JWT auth working, admin dashboard shows real data (6 orders, ₹32,025 revenue, 6 products), CRUD operations working.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login with admin@kridhanijewels.com / admin123 returns 200 with user data and httpOnly cookie
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with OLD credentials (admin@kridhani.com) returns 401 - Firebase credentials no longer work
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns 401
Backend: GET /api/auth/me without token returns 401
Backend: GET /api/auth/me with valid token returns user data
Backend: POST /api/auth/logout clears cookie and subsequent /api/auth/me returns 401
Backend: GET /api/dashboard/stats requires auth (401 without token)
Backend: GET /api/dashboard/stats returns totalOrders, totalRevenue, totalProducts, pendingOrders, recentOrders
Backend: GET /api/products is public (no auth required)
Backend: POST /api/products requires auth (401 without token)
Backend: Full product CRUD: Create → GET verify → Delete → GET verify 404
Backend: GET /api/orders requires auth (401 without token)
Backend: GET /api/orders returns order list with customer data
Backend: PATCH /api/orders/{order_id}/status updates order status
Backend: GET /api/categories returns category list
Backend: Products use MongoDB ObjectId format (24 hex chars), not Firebase IDs
Frontend: No Firebase SDK loaded on homepage (window.firebase undefined, no firebase scripts)
Frontend: No Firebase/Firestore text on login page
Frontend: Admin login with admin@kridhanijewels.com / admin123 redirects to /admin/dashboard
Frontend: Dashboard shows Total Orders (6), Total Revenue (₹32,025), Pending Orders (1), Total Products (6)
Frontend: Dashboard shows Recent Orders table with real data (customer names, amounts, statuses)
Frontend: WhatsApp button visible on homepage, hidden on admin pages
Frontend: Products page loads 6 products from MongoDB API
Frontend: Add Product form works - product created and appears in list
Frontend: Delete Product works - product removed from list
Frontend: Orders page shows 6 orders with customer names, phone, amounts, statuses
Frontend: Order status update works (changed to 'delivered', toast shown)
Frontend: Logout redirects to /admin/login
Frontend: Protected route /admin/dashboard redirects to /admin/login without auth
Frontend: Old route /firebase-admin/login redirects to /admin/login
Frontend: Public storefront shows products from MongoDB API
Frontend: Search feature works - typing 'Vyahula' shows 1 result for Vyahula Mor product
critical_code_review_comments: Firebase completely removed - no firebase.js, no firebase npm package, no Firebase env vars
JWT auth implemented correctly with httpOnly cookies and proper token validation
Admin user seeded on startup with idempotent update (updates password if changed)
All admin routes properly protected with get_current_user dependency
MongoDB ObjectId properly converted to string in API responses
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - using existing 6 orders and 6 products
context_for_next_testing_agent: Firebase has been completely removed and replaced with JWT-based auth. Admin credentials are admin@kridhanijewels.com / admin123 (old Firebase credentials admin@kridhani.com no longer work). All data comes from MongoDB via FastAPI backend. Dashboard shows 6 orders totaling ₹32,025 and 6 products. Razorpay payment integration still active.
